caption: The drawing depicts a large brass bell mounted on a dark metal frame consisting of two curved vertical supports and a rounded horizontal structure at the top, capped with a spherical ornament. The bell itself has a golden yellow color with subtle shading that suggests a metallic sheen, while the frame is rendered in darker, brownish-black tones with areas of light and shadow indicating its three-dimensional form. The bell's clapper is visible beneath its rim, showing a slight red or purplish hue. The frame contains additional smaller elements, including side bolts and feet, which are also colored in dark shades. The composition is centered on the page, with the bell occupying the majority of the space, and the background is a plain, light beige. The artist's signature, “L. BHARTMANN,” is present in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Bell
